summary: flush queues a compression-engine flush behind pending stream writes and may reduce compression quality.

target.notes: Preserve Node Buffer/options/error semantics; platform compression libraries are usable only behind this compatibility contract.

semantics.queueing: stream operation, not OS stream flush
semantics.defaults: Z_FULL_FLUSH for zlib streams; BROTLI_OPERATION_FLUSH for Brotli

tests.name: normal
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createGzip(); s.flush(()=>console.log('flushed')); s.end('x');

tests.name: edge
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createGzip(); s.write('x'); s.flush(); s.end();
